title: Money as integer minor units
statement: Store all money as integer minor units (amount_cents, currency ISO-4217). Never use floats or Decimal in TypeScript for prices.
rationale: Floating-point totals produced rounding bugs in the first checkout prototype.
quote: Everything that is money is an integer number of cents — amount_cents plus an ISO currency code. No floats, ever.

title: Route handler response envelope
statement: All route handlers return { success: boolean, data?: T, error?: { code: string, message: string } } with an HTTP status matching the error.
rationale: Clients parse one shape; ad-hoc payloads broke the mobile web client twice.
quote: Every handler answers with the same envelope: success, optional data, optional error with code and message.

title: Route handler location and validation
statement: Route handlers live at app/api/<resource>/route.ts and validate input with zod schemas from lib/validation.
rationale: Consistent structure makes handlers easy to find and review.
quote: New endpoints go in app/api/<resource>/route.ts and parse input with the zod schemas in lib/validation.

title: Never log PII
statement: Never log email, address, phone or payment details; use logger.redact() on user objects.
rationale: PII in logs failed the May compliance review.
quote: No email, address, phone or card data in logs. Wrap user objects in logger.redact() before logging.

title: Stripe webhook handling
statement: The Stripe webhook route reads the raw body with await req.text(), verifies with stripe.webhooks.constructEvent, runs on the nodejs runtime, and records event.id in stripe_events for idempotency.
rationale: Signature failures and double processing happened before this rule.
quote: Webhook route: raw body via req.text(), constructEvent to verify, nodejs runtime, and store event.id in stripe_events so we never process twice.

title: Prisma client singleton
statement: /checkout returned 504s because handlers created new PrismaClient() per request and exhausted connections. Always import the singleton db from @/lib/db.
rationale: Per-request clients exhausted Postgres connections under load.
quote: Root cause: every handler did new PrismaClient(). From now on, import { db } from '@/lib/db' — the singleton — everywhere.

title: API connection pool size
statement: Set connection_limit=25 on the API DATABASE_URL.
rationale: Chosen after the June checkout incident to give each API instance headroom.
quote: Let's give the API pool connection_limit=25 on DATABASE_URL.

title: Redis carts lost data
statement: Tried storing carts in Redis with a 24 h TTL; carts vanished for returning users. Reverted. Carts live in the Postgres carts table; Redis is only for rate limiting.
rationale: Returning shoppers lost their carts after the TTL expired.
quote: Redis carts with a 24h TTL lost carts for anyone who came back later. We reverted — carts stay in Postgres, Redis is only for rate limiting.

title: Soft-delete orders
statement: Orders and order items are soft-deleted via deleted_at; never hard-delete (7-year tax retention). All order queries filter deleted_at IS NULL.
rationale: Tax auditors require 7 years of order history.
quote: We never hard-delete orders — set deleted_at and filter on deleted_at IS NULL. Auditors need seven years.

title: Migrations only via CI
statement: Only CI runs prisma migrate deploy using DIRECT_URL; never run prisma migrate dev against staging or production.
rationale: A manual migrate dev against staging caused schema drift.
quote: Only the CI pipeline runs prisma migrate deploy with DIRECT_URL. Nobody runs migrate dev against staging or prod again.

title: UI components and styling
statement: Shared UI components live in components/ui and use Tailwind design tokens (no hex values, no inline styles). Server Components by default; add "use client" only for interactivity.
rationale: Keeps the design system consistent and bundles small.
quote: Shared components go in components/ui, Tailwind tokens only — no hex values and no inline styles. Server Components unless you need interactivity.

title: Auth endpoint rate limit
statement: Auth endpoints are rate-limited to 5 requests/min/IP with @upstash/ratelimit; over-limit returns 429 with error code RATE_LIMITED.
rationale: A credential-stuffing incident hit /api/auth/login in August.
quote: Login, signup and reset get @upstash/ratelimit at 5 per minute per IP, and over the limit we return 429 RATE_LIMITED.

title: Every bug fix ships a regression test
statement: Every bug fix ships a regression test: Vitest for logic, Playwright for flows.
rationale: Team rule agreed in the August retro.
quote: Team rule: no bug fix merges without a regression test — Vitest for logic, Playwright for flows.
